items.title: Since the COVID low (16 Mar 2020): Bitcoin up, altcoins down in BTC (16 Mar 2020 = 100)
items.description: Since the 16 Mar 2020 COVID low, bitcoin in dollars vs the median altcoin priced in BTC (with 25th and 75th percentiles); the median alt has lost about 90% against bitcoin.
items.reason: Bitcoin slipped below $67K and crypto lost about $230B overnight, with ether under $1,900 and solana under $75; this shows how much worse alts have done.

items.title: SpaceX share of all payload mass launched to space each year
items.description: Payload mass launched each year by SpaceX vs the rest of the world, with SpaceX's share of the total, 2012 to H1 2026.
items.reason: Starship Flight 15 reached orbit, deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites and the ship was caught by the tower.

items.title: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions: 1.74M, up 67% in a year (Q3 2026)
items.description: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions by quarter, Q2 2025 to Q3 2026: 1.74M, up 67% in a year.
items.reason: Tesla put up its first Times Square billboard to advertise Full Self-Driving.

items.title: Borrowing for AI: total debt at each fiscal year end vs the latest quarter
items.description: Total debt at Oracle, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet and CoreWeave at each fiscal year end since FY2021 vs the latest quarter (Jun 2026).
items.reason: The Fed's new financial stability report flags AI-related debt as a top risk.

items.title: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield
items.description: The 10-year US Treasury yield since 2000 (FRED), now back near the top of its range.
items.reason: Yields above 5% and a 19-month high in the dollar knocked gold to its lowest in over a year.
